standard_prerequisites.name: A scheme with an ample invertible module is quasi-compact and separated, and objects of the derived category of quasi-coherent modules are represented by complexes of quasi-coherent modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Sets up the complex representative F^bullet of K.

standard_prerequisites.name: Sections of a quasi-coherent module over the affine open of a section of a power of an ample sheaf lift to global sections of the module twisted by a further power of the sheaf
standard_prerequisites.use: Lifts the local class to a global twisted class in two steps.

core_obligations: Since X has an ample invertible sheaf it is quasi-compact and separated (Properties, Definition ample and Lemma affine-s-opens-cover-quasi-separated); by Proposition quasi-compact-affine-diagonal represent K by a complex F^bullet of quasi-coherent modules; pick p with the cohomology sheaf H^p nonzero and a point x with nonzero stalk (proof lines 4294-4307).

Choose n >= 0 and a section s of L^{tensor n} with X_s an affine open neighbourhood of x; choose tau in H^p(X_s) mapping to a nonzero element of the stalk, possible since H^p is quasi-coherent and X_s affine; since sections over X_s form an exact functor, find tau' in F^p(X_s) mapping to zero in F^{p+1}(X_s) and to tau in H^p(X_s) (proof lines 4308-4313).

By Properties, Lemma invert-s-sections there is m with tau' tensor s^{tensor m} the image of a global section tau'' of F^p tensor L^{tensor mn}; applying the lemma again, find l >= 0 such that tau'' tensor s^{tensor l} maps to zero in F^{p+1} tensor L^{tensor (m+l)n}; then tau'' defines a nonzero class in H^p(X, K tensor^L L^{tensor (m+l)n}), proving the lemma (proof lines 4314-4324).
proof_roadmap: Represent K by a complex of quasi-coherent modules and pick a nonzero cohomology class at a point (proof lines 4294-4307).
Spread the class over an affine open of a section of a power of L (proof lines 4308-4313).
Lift to a global twisted section in two steps via the section-inverting lemma and read off the nonzero cohomology class (proof lines 4314-4324).
